budget.artifactDeclaredAtRoundZero: Two working-contract docs changes: the Replit fast lane (display-vs-behavior boundary, sweep cadence) and Fable-to-explore/Opus-to-build. Docs and contract text only, no product code.

findings.note: unresolved/resolved is THREAD state, not code state. An unresolved thread may already be fixed and awaiting a reply; isOutdated only tracks whether the anchored hunk moved. Treat these as 'what the reviewer has not yet been told is closed', never as 'what is still broken'.

items.excerpt: P2 Update the live skills that still forbid this switch
P2 Qualify the existing every-actor main rule
P2 Wire the opportunistic sweep into the first-fetch path
P2 Reconcile fast-lane tweaks with mandatory workstream tracking
P2 Keep the weekly sweep explicitly manual
P2 Sweep every Replit commit since the previous fetch
P2 Retire the remaining no-switch instructions
P2 Add the fast-lane exception to the root tracking rule
P2 Apply the display-versus-behavior rule in maintenance

P2 Preserve Replit commits beyond the 14-day window. After more than 14 days with neither a working session nor /maintenance, --since="14 days ago" excludes the unseen commit permanently. Claims the filter returns only 1 of the repository's 146 matching Replit commits. Use a durable pre-fetch boundary or another window that cannot age unseen commits out.

P2 Record the maintenance cadence as David-invoked. The decisions.md entry still says David invokes neither cadence, while replit-environment.md and CLAUDE.md were corrected in this revision to make /maintenance David-invoked and unscheduled.

territory.note: Territory is mechanical (finding path vs. this PR's changed files). CAUSE (new-ground / propagation / wrong-fix / re-raised) is NOT derivable -- it has no machine-readable marker, and is deliberately left unclassified rather than guessed.

sinceLastReview.note: Branch movement since the last reviewed commit -- NOT the PR's diff. After a merge from the base branch this includes files already reviewed and merged there. Use `artifact` for the size of what is actually under review here.
